title: One More and One Less
seo_title: Kindergarten One More and One Less Worksheets (TEKS K.2F)
standard_text: K.2F generate a number that is one more than or one less than another number up to at least 20
meta_desc: Free kindergarten worksheets for Texas TEKS K.2F: one more and one less with pictures, numbers to 20 and stories. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: 1 more is the next number; 1 less is the number before.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 1 more is the next number when you count: 1 more than 7 is 8.
  • 1 less is the number just before: 1 less than 7 is 6.
  • Use a number line or your fingers to check.

Examples

Example

1 more than 12

12, 13

Answer: 13

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Giving the same number1 more changes the number.
Going the wrong wayMore goes up; less goes down.
Changing by 2Count just 1.
